title: POS Configs
description: Point of sale shops and till settings.

help.title: About POS Configs
help.overview: A POS config is one till: its payment buttons, the warehouses it sells from, its currency, receipts, fiscalization, and what the cashier is allowed to do. A cashier opens a session on it from the Point of Sale page.

sections.title: What a till needs
sections.body: Name, at least one payment method, and at least one warehouse are required.
items: Payment methods are the buttons on the till, in their sequence order. Only active methods can be assigned.

Warehouses are where the till's stock comes from, in order: a sale fills from the first, then the next. Only active warehouses can be assigned. The first warehouse's address also decides the VAT rates of till sales.
Currency is required to open a session and sell.
Fiscal config links the till to Albanian CIS fiscalization. Without one, the till does not fiscalize.
Receipt header and footer are printed on every receipt.

sections.title: Cashier controls
sections.body: These switches decide what the cashier may do without a manager.
items: Allow discount and allow quantity change unlock those edits on the till.
Allow oversell lets a sale go through even when the warehouses do not hold enough stock; the shortfall is taken from the last warehouse.
PIN for discount, PIN for cash out, and PIN for refund require a manager PIN for that action.
Cash control tracks the drawer; barcode scanner turns scanning on.

sections.title: Managers and PINs
sections.body: Managers are the users allowed to approve PIN-protected actions on this till.
items: Each manager sets their own PIN, can change it with the current PIN, or clear it.
A forgotten PIN can be reset through an emailed link that is valid for 24 hours and works once.
Removing a user from managers also removes their PIN from the till.

sections.title: Active, paused, and the company lock
sections.body: Three switches stop a till from taking money.
items: Deactivate turns the till off and force-closes its open sessions; it cannot be opened again until activated.
Pause stops sales on one till with an optional reason and force-closes its open sessions: held carts are cancelled and in-flight terminal payments are voided where possible. Resume lifts it.
Pause all tills sets a company-wide lock and force-closes every open session. While it is on, no till can be resumed. Resume all clears only the company lock; tills paused one by one stay paused.

sections.title: Related settings
items: Payment methods and fiscal configs are their own pages under Configurations.
A warehouse that is the only warehouse of a till cannot be deactivated or deleted; one shared with other warehouses is removed from the till instead.
Deleting a till is a soft delete and it can be restored.

bulkMenu.label: Company controls
bulkMenu.pauseAllHint: Lock the company and force-close open sessions
bulkMenu.resumeAllHint: Clear the company lock only. Individually paused tills stay paused
